name: circuit-monorepo
description: The erisera OSS design system monorepo — CSS foundation (@erisera-code/circuit), React components (@erisera-code/circuit-react) and the class-free design engine with swappable instances (@erisera-code/circuit-engine).
author: John Henry

scripts.build: npm run build -w @erisera-code/circuit && npm run build -w @erisera-code/circuit-react && npm run build -w @erisera-code/circuit-engine
scripts.test: npm run check:css && npm run check:rails && npm test -w @erisera-code/circuit && npm test -w @erisera-code/circuit-engine
